title.zh: 会话永久删除 · Session Delete Easy

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话彻底删掉（日志/归属/归档/缓存），而不只是归档。
description.en: Permanent session deletion for DeepSeek Harness, not just archiving.

description.zh: 在会话菜单里加一项「删除会话」：删掉对话日志、工作区归属、归档/置顶状态与投影缓存。仍打开的会话先隐藏，下次启动时删除日志。另含 session_delete / session_delete_list 两个工具。
description.en: Adds Delete session to the session menu: removes the conversation log, workspace membership, archive and pin state, and cached projections. A session still open is hidden now and erased at the next start. Also registers the session_delete and session_delete_list tools.
